testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle a panel from the left-docked ribbon selector: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:504:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle a panel from the left-docked ribbon selector ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify visible ✔ When the user clicks the direct panel selector at the bottom of the ribbon ✔ Then the panel checklist opens with Modify checked ✔ When the user clicks Modify in the checklist ✔ Then Modify is unchecked and its panel is absent from the ribbon ✔ And the checklist remains open ✔ When the user clicks Modify in the checklist again ✔ Then Modify is checked and its panel is visible on the left-docked ribbon ✔ And the checklist remains open
